name: Curse of the Forbidden Ones
description:
Attacks deal +5❤️ to enemies with a [effect:name][dark-gray]forbidden name[/dark-gray][/effect], but -5❤️ damage otherwise.

  • [term:curse][red]Curse Spell[/red][/term]: [dark-red]Sacrifice 1❤️[/dark-red] to form Dead Obelisk in front of you. [effect:sacrifice][dark-gray]Sacrificing[/dark-gray][/effect] 10❤️ or 4 enemies near the obelisk awakens it as an allied Abomination.

effects.explanation: These sacrifices can be mixed. For example, sacrificing 5❤️ and 2 enemies awakens the Abomination.
